thesis: The page is the attic itself, read off the cardboard depth rulers Inchwise staples to the rafters: every section is one ruler reading, and the loose-fill rises up those rulers as you scroll until the attic reaches its target.

signature.name: Stapled Depth Rulers
signature.summary: A drawn cardboard insulation ruler (yellow card, inch ticks, two staple marks, finding number F-01..F-06) stuck upright in a band of drawn loose-fill. Hero: six rulers in a drawn attic cut fill to six different readings, the thin one turns orange. Story: one big ruler pinned beside a ranch attic cross-section, fill climbs 3.5 to 17 in past dashed R-49 and R-60 lines. Services: each line item carries a mini ruler showing its reading. Reviews: homeowner notes clipped to a ruler stub. Form: the last ruler reads your depth. Footer: a ruler laid flat as the sign-off rule.

palette.family: Carbonless Paper + Rafter Graphite + Below-Target Orange + Ruler Card Yellow

layoutMoves: A 72px left margin column on desktop holds each section's ruler and finding number; content starts on column 2
Hero: hero-B3 framed off-axis as report photo plate P-01 (rotated -1.5deg, corner tape), the drawn six-ruler attic cut overlaps its lower edge and the h1 overlaps its left edge
Readings set huge in Martian Mono (3.5 in) against small Bitter labels: number-first hierarchy in every finding
Pinned horizontal-cut story on desktop, stacked ruler cards under 640px
Section rhythm paper -> mid -> paper -> deep -> paper -> accent band -> deep footer, never two darks touching

motion.intro: Photo plate drops 8px and settles (400ms), then the six hero rulers fill bottom-up to their readings with a 60ms stagger and the thin one flips orange; total 1.1s, skipped under reduced motion.
stories: fill: pinned ruler beside a drawn ranch attic, loose-fill rises 3.5 -> 17 in with scroll, R estimate counts 10 -> 51, dashed R-49 and R-60 lines light as it passes them
motion.hover: Ruler nudge: on hover/focus a card's ruler fill rises 4px and its tick label goes bold (200ms ease-out).
